flashcards.back: Speedup = 1 / ((1-F) + F/S). Overall speedup is limited by the unaffected fraction (1-F).
CPU time = Instruction Count × CPI × Clock Cycle Time. The three knobs every architecture decision turns.
P = ½ × C × V² × f × α. Burned charging/discharging gate capacitance during switching.
Leakage current that flows even when not switching. Dominant problem at sub-22nm nodes.
Availability = MTTF / (MTTF + MTTR). Five nines = 99.999% = ~5 min downtime/year.
It's invariant to the choice of normalization reference machine; arithmetic mean is not.
Compulsory (first access), Capacity (working set > cache), Conflict (set associativity insufficient).
Coherence — invalidations from other cores in a multicore system.
Average Memory Access Time = Hit_time + Miss_rate × Miss_penalty. Recurses for multi-level caches.
Write-back: update cache, mark dirty, write to memory on eviction. Write-through: every write goes to memory.
Cache that services hits while a miss is outstanding (hit-under-miss, miss-under-miss). Required for OoO.
Translation Lookaside Buffer — small cache of virtual→physical page mappings. Miss = page walk; fault = OS swap-in.
Extended/Nested Page Tables — hardware support for 2-level translation in VMs (guest virt → guest phys → host phys).
Read After Write — a true (flow) dependence. Cannot be removed by renaming.
Write After Read — anti-dependence. Removed by register renaming.
Write After Write — output dependence. Removed by register renaming.
OoO with reservation stations + CDB + register status table. Handles RAW; eliminates WAR/WAW via implicit renaming.
FIFO that holds in-flight instructions in program order. Enables precise exceptions and speculation rollback.
Saturating counter (00=strongly NT, 01=weakly NT, 10=weakly T, 11=strongly T). Must mispredict twice to flip.
Combines a local and global predictor with a meta-predictor that picks per-branch which to trust.
Simultaneous Multithreading — multiple threads issue in same cycle, sharing FUs/ROB. ~5% area for ~30% throughput.
Realistic integer ILP ~4-6, FP ~6-12. Branch prediction and memory aliasing are the gating factors.
Data-Level Parallelism — same operation on many data elements. Exploited by vector, SIMD, GPU.
Performance ceiling = min(peak_compute, bandwidth × operational_intensity). Diagnoses compute vs memory bound.
Single Instruction Multiple Thread — NVIDIA's GPU model. Threads grouped into 32-thread warps run in lockstep.
Threads in a warp take different branches → hardware serializes both paths with masking. Halves throughput.
GPU hardware combines aligned/contiguous accesses from a warp into fewer memory transactions. Critical for bandwidth.
Modified, Exclusive, Shared, Invalid. Cache coherence protocol. E enables silent E→M (no broadcast on first write).
MOESI adds Owned state — one cache supplies data on snoop without writing back to memory.
Snooping: O(N²) broadcast traffic, simple, ~16-32 cores max. Directory: point-to-point, scales to 100s+ cores.
All processors see operations in some total order; each processor's order matches program order. Strict, expensive.
Total Store Order — only allows store→load reordering (load can pass earlier store to different address).
Most reorderings allowed; programmer inserts DMB/DSB barriers for ordering. Acquire/release semantics.
Two cores write different bytes on same cache line, causing line to ping-pong. Fix: align/pad to cache line.
Warehouse-Scale Computer — homogeneous, single-owner, single-admin facility designed as one machine. Failure is routine.
Map(k,v)→list((k',v')); Reduce(k', list(v'))→output. Locality-aware, failure-tolerant batch model.
Power Usage Effectiveness = total facility power / IT equipment power. Modern WSC: ~1.1 (Google), enterprise: ~2.0.
RISC: fixed-length, load-store, simple. CISC: variable-length, mem operands, complex insts. Modern x86 = CISC frontend, RISC backend.
DM: 1 line per index. SA: n lines per set (parallel tag compare). FA: any line. Tradeoff: hit time vs miss rate.
IF, ID, EX, MEM, WB. Throughput 1 IPC steady-state, latency 5 cycles.
Dependent instruction needs load result that isn't available until end of MEM. Requires 1 stall cycle (or compiler scheduling).
On exception, all earlier insts complete, no later inst has effect. Required for VM, debugging. ROB enables in OoO.
